description: This file defines a utility enum GatewayRemoteConfig that contains methods for parsing and normalizing remote gateway configuration data, including resolving transport types, URLs, tokens, and handling URL normalization and default port assignment. It is specifically focused on remote gateway configuration for a networked application, likely dealing with WebSocket URLs and token management.

methods.name: resolveTransport
methods.description: Determines the transport type (direct or ssh) based on the nested 'gateway' configuration dictionary.

methods.name: resolveUrlString
methods.description: Extracts and trims the 'url' string from the nested configuration, returning nil if absent or empty.

methods.name: resolveTokenValue
methods.description: Retrieves and processes the 'token' value, returning a TokenValue enum indicating missing, unsupported, or plaintext token.

methods.name: resolveTokenString
methods.description: Returns the token string if it exists as a plaintext token, otherwise nil.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Creates a URL object from the normalized URL string, or nil if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrlString
methods.description: Returns the absolute string of a normalized URL, or nil if normalization fails.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a WebSocket URL, ensuring schemes are correct, hosts are loopback if ws, and adding default port if missing.

methods.name: defaultPort
methods.description: Returns the default port for WebSocket secure (443) or insecure (18789) URLs, or nil for others.
